content.text: experimented on ubuntu 20.04 with different strategies and couldnt get tsan messages to go away. Not sure - but these appear to be false-positives due to how sqlite implements its thread safety logic.
FOR NOW - l leave this open and try suppressions.
Added TSAN and helgrind suppressions for this issue (which is probably real, but again - maybe just a quirk of the internal thread checking done in sqlite)
still fails on ununtu 20.04 if you first remove the
bug workaround defines. So - upping priority here to High, since this is more likely something real (though maybe my bug still).
TSAN and VALGRIND report a bunch of warnings about use of sqlite with threads.
It COULD be my usage. But more likely a flaw with the the sqlite threading code, or just false positives.
